title: A salient attribute gets extra weight
hook: Two stated cases: explore the weight assigned to a prominent attribute.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the weight assigned to a prominent attribute affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Estimate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the weight assigned to a prominent attribute in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
